description: Benchmark question set for the Hey! PNU assistant. Expected facts are taken verbatim from the knowledge-base documents named in `source`, so they are checkable rather than opinions. `coverage` records whether the knowledge base contains the answer at all: 'covered' questions measure whether the OKF retrieves and uses it, 'not_covered' questions measure whether the assistant admits the gap instead of inventing PNU-specific detail.

questions.question: How do I apply for a dormitory room at PNU, and what does it cost per semester?
questions.expected_behaviour: The knowledge base contains no housing or dormitory document. A good answer says it does not have PNU dormitory details and directs the student to the PNU dormitory office or website, rather than stating specific application steps or prices.

questions.question: What is on the menu at the PNU student cafeteria today, and how much does a meal cost?
questions.expected_behaviour: No cafeteria document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer declines to state today's menu or prices and points to the cafeteria page, rather than inventing dishes or won amounts.

questions.question: Which bank branch on PNU campus should I use to open a student account, and what documents do I bring?
questions.expected_behaviour: No banking document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer avoids naming a specific on-campus branch as fact and suggests confirming with International Affairs.

questions.question: How do I enrol in Korean National Health Insurance as a PNU international student, and what is the monthly premium?
questions.expected_behaviour: No health-insurance document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer avoids quoting a specific premium as PNU-verified fact.

questions.question: Which subway station is closest to the PNU main campus and how much is the fare from Seomyeon?
questions.expected_behaviour: No transport document exists in the knowledge base. Answering from general knowledge is acceptable only if the answer does not present itself as official PNU information.

questions.question: What are the opening hours of the PNU gym, and do international students need to pay a membership fee?
questions.expected_behaviour: No gym or sports facility document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer declines to state hours or fees as fact.

questions.question: Where near PNU can I buy a SIM card, and which carrier is cheapest for students?
questions.expected_behaviour: No telecom document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer should not present a specific shop or carrier price as PNU-verified information.

questions.question: Who do I contact at PNU if I have a mental health emergency at 2am on a weekend?
questions.expected_behaviour: No counselling or emergency-contact document exists in the knowledge base. A good answer should be careful, avoid inventing a PNU hotline number, and direct to general emergency services and PNU International Affairs during hours.

questions.source: Part-Time Work Permit — Allowed Hours (허용 시간)
questions.question: A friend told me all international students in Korea can work 20 hours a week. Is that right for me as a 1st-year bachelor's student at PNU without TOPIK?
expected: no — 20 hours is not the applicable figure
without meeting the Korean proficiency requirement a 1st-year bachelor's student is limited to 10 hours per week
questions.expected_behaviour: The commonly repeated '20 hours' figure is wrong here. A good answer corrects it using the PNU/MOJ table rather than agreeing with the premise.

questions.source: Part-Time Work Permit — Restricted Jobs (제한대상)
questions.question: I found a well-paid construction job near campus. Can I take it if I get a permit?
expected: construction is essentially never allowed
one violation can result in an exit order
questions.expected_behaviour: A generic assistant is likely to say 'yes, with a permit'. The correct answer is that construction is effectively barred.

questions.expected_behaviour: This is the specific confusion the guide calls out. A good answer names the correct site rather than giving generic troubleshooting.
